Each layout of a flexible content field and the kit section its rows became. **unmapped** rows are not sections: on a collection entry they stay in the field as data; on a page they block the transform gate unless the page was rebuilt from its rendered HTML. Force a section type or skip a layout in `overrides.ts → acfLayouts: { <layout>: "<section type>" | "skip" }`.
| Field | Layout | Where | Rows | Became | Not carried |
| `blocks` | Quote (`quote`) | project harbor-rebrand, project city-site | 2 | rich_text | author |
| `page_sections` | Text and image (`text_image`) | page home | 1 | media_text | — |
## ACF fields on pages and posts

Field values a theme template showed around the page content. Pages and posts have no custom fields of their own on EmDash: where the page was rebuilt from its rendered HTML the values are part of it; otherwise add them to the page in the admin (or as a section), or decide they are not needed.
| Type | Field | ACF type | Entries with a value | Shown through the rendered page | Sample |
| page | Note above the footer (`hero_note`) | text | 1: home | ⚠️ no | Shown above the footer |
| post | Reading time (`reading_time`) | number | 1: hello | ⚠️ no | 4 |

Site-wide settings from ACF options page(s) (`site-settings`). EmDash has no options pages: carry what the new site shows (contact details, social links, footer text) into Settings, a site part or a section, and decide the rest. Values read from the database backup (raw/acf-options.json).
| Footer text (`footer_text`) | textarea | Site settings | Made in Example City |
| SMTP password (`smtp_password`) | password | Site settings | not carried (secret) |
Options rows no field definition describes (names only): `options_legacy_banner`.
